title: 完整句与句间标点
goal: 识别缺少主句或谓语的句子；正确连接两个独立分句。

points.label: 识别缺少主句或谓语的句子
正确连接两个独立分句

sources.title: 大学英语六级（CET-6）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分本课的内容范围、知识点与练习规格

body.p: 完整的句子要有主语和限定谓语。整句由 because、although 等从属连词引导时，只是从句。Having a plan 是非谓语短语，Because the plan changed 是从句，二者都不能单独成句。

body.box: Having a plan helps the team. Because the plan changed, the team revised its schedule.

body.p: 两个完整的独立分句不能只用逗号连接。改法有三种。用句号分成两句。用逗号加 and、but、so 等并列连词。用从属连词把其中一句变成原因、条件或让步从句。

cards.title: 从句片段
rows: 原因片段
补上主句，或去掉 because 单独成句。
Fragment: Because the cable was loose. Revision: Because the cable was loose, the connection failed.
让步片段
although 后面即使有主谓，也是从句，要补上主句。
Fragment: Although the room was small. Revision: Although the room was small, it held the display.
条件片段
if 从句说明条件，主句说明这个条件下的结果。
Fragment: If the seal breaks. Revision: If the seal breaks, the contents may spill.
删除连接词
去掉连接词能成句，原因关系也随之消失。
Because the label faded. → The label faded.

cards.title: 非谓语片段
rows: 现在分词
主语后只有 doing，要补 be 构成谓语。
Fragment: The assistants sorting the cards. Revision: The assistants were sorting the cards.
不定式
to do 不能单独作谓语，改成 will do 等限定形式。
Fragment: The manager to review the figures. Revision: The manager will review the figures.
过去分词
表示被动时，done 前面要加 be。
Fragment: The dates recorded on the form. Revision: The dates were recorded on the form.
名词化动作
动名词可以作主语，句子另有谓语。
Checking the total takes time.

cards.title: 独立分句的连接
rows: 句号
分成两句，后一句首字母大写。
Error: The gate closed, the crowd waited. Revision: The gate closed. The crowd waited.
并列连词
逗号加 and、but、so，按两句的关系选连词。
Error: The draft is short, it covers the essentials. Revision: The draft is short, but it covers the essentials.
从属连词
两句有因果关系时，把表示原因的一句改成 because 从句。
Error: The file was locked, the editor requested access. Revision: Because the file was locked, the editor requested access.
分号
紧密相关的独立分句可用分号连接。
The notice was revised; the old version was removed.

body.box: Because the entrance was being repaired. Visitors used the side door. The attendants guiding them along a marked path. The route was longer, it kept visitors away from the work area.
Because the entrance was being repaired, visitors used the side door. The attendants were guiding them along a marked path. The route was longer, but it kept visitors away from the work area.

body.p: 第一处原来只有 because 从句，与下一句合并后，visitors used 是主句。第二处补上 were，were guiding 构成谓语。第三处加 but，表示路线虽长，却能让游客远离施工区。
改正时不必把所有句子合成长句。入口施工和改走侧门有因果关系，所以合并。其他信息分句写，关系更清楚。

items.stem: Which version is a complete sentence rather than a dependent fragment?
options: Although the ink had dried, the pages still needed to be checked.
Although the ink had dried before the pages were checked.
Because the ink had dried before the pages were checked.
If the ink had dried before the pages were checked.
items.why: 第一项在 Although 从句后有主句 the pages still needed，是完整的句子。其余三项都只有从句。

items.stem: Which revision gives the subject a finite verb?
options: The assistants preparing the display beside the entrance.
The assistants were preparing the display beside the entrance.
The assistants to prepare the display beside the entrance.
The assistants having prepared the display beside the entrance.
items.why: were preparing 里的 were 是限定动词，即第二项。其余三项只有非谓语形式。

items.stem: Which sentence correctly joins the contrast between a clear label and a faded date?
options: The label is clear, the date has faded.
The label is clear but, the date has faded.
The label is clear, but the date has faded.
Although the label is clear, but the date has faded.
items.why: 逗号加 but 连接两个独立分句，即第三项。第四项 although 和 but 重复使用。

items.stem: Which revision makes the blocked path the cause of the changed route?
options: The path was blocked, the courier changed the route.
The path was blocked because the courier changed the route.
Because the path was blocked. The courier changed the route.
Because the path was blocked, the courier changed the route.
items.why: because 后面是原因，主句是结果，即第四项。第二项把因果说反了。

items.stem: Complete a sentence in which checking the display is the subject.
items.why: Checking the display 作主语，requires 为限定谓语。

items.stem: Supply a main clause after the reason clause.
items.why: the attendants directed 构成主句。directing 不是限定谓语。

items.stem: Join the two independent clauses with a contrast.
items.why: but 连接两个独立分句，表示转折。although 会把后一句变成从句，不符合题目要求。

items.stem: Make the delay a result of the missing signature.
items.why: so 引出结果。用 because 会把因果说反。

items.stem: Which version is a complete sentence with a main clause rather than a fragment?
options: Although the revised instructions included a diagram, several unfamiliar terms still required an explanation before the equipment could be used confidently.
Although the revised instructions included a diagram explaining several unfamiliar terms that had previously prevented the equipment from being used confidently.
Because the revised instructions included a diagram explaining several unfamiliar terms that had previously prevented the equipment from being used confidently.
If the revised instructions included a diagram explaining several unfamiliar terms that had previously prevented the equipment from being used confidently.
items.why: 第一项在 Although 从句之后有主句 several unfamiliar terms still required。其余三项整句都是从句。

items.stem: Which revision supplies the finite predicate missing from “The volunteers checking the names against the original register”?
options: The volunteers checking the names against the original register before allowing the participants to enter the reserved area of the hall.
The volunteers were checking the names against the original register before allowing the participants to enter the reserved area of the hall.
The volunteers to check the names against the original register before allowing the participants to enter the reserved area of the hall.
The volunteers having checked the names against the original register before allowing the participants to enter the reserved area of the hall.
items.why: were checking 是限定谓语，即第二项。checking、to check、having checked 都不能单独作谓语。

items.stem: Which revision preserves both independent statements and removes the comma splice?
options: The booking list was updated, the receptionist printed a new copy for the attendants who were preparing the entrance for the evening event.
The booking list was updated the receptionist printed a new copy for the attendants who were preparing the entrance for the evening event.
The booking list was updated. The receptionist printed a new copy for the attendants who were preparing the entrance for the evening event.
The booking list was updated, printing a new copy by the receptionist for the attendants who were preparing the entrance for the evening event.
items.why: 第三项用句号分开 was updated 和 printed 两个完整分句。第四项把 printed 改成 printing，receptionist 不再是做事的人。

items.stem: The damaged hinge caused the staff to close the cabinet. Which version preserves this cause and forms a complete sentence?
options: The hinge was damaged because the staff closed the cabinet and transferred the contents to a secure container in the adjoining room.
Because the hinge was damaged. The staff closed the cabinet and transferred the contents to a secure container in the adjoining room.
The hinge was damaged, the staff closed the cabinet and transferred the contents to a secure container in the adjoining room.
Because the hinge was damaged, the staff closed the cabinet and transferred the contents to a secure container in the adjoining room.
items.why: hinge was damaged 是原因，staff closed 是结果。第四项用 because 从句加主句，是完整的句子。

items.stem: Complete the main clause after the dependent clause about a missing reference code.
items.lead: Because the reference code was missing,
items.tail: that had been placed among the recently received papers.
items.why: the archivist could not identify 是主句。unable to identify 没有限定动词。

items.stem: Give the gerund subject a finite predicate in a statement about comparing records.
items.tail: that would otherwise be difficult to detect during a brief inspection.
items.why: Comparing the separate records 作主语，reveals 作谓语。revealing 不能作谓语。

items.stem: Join the statements with the stated contrast between availability and insufficient detail.
items.tail: that staff needed to complete before accepting a request.
items.why: but 接独立分句，与前句构成转折：指南能在网上找到，内容却不全。

items.stem: Express the result of an unreadable address through a coordinating conjunction.
items.tail: before attempting delivery to a building on the wrong street.
items.why: so 引出结果，asked the sender to confirm 是结果的内容。用 because 会把因果说反。
